name: DrumRingCarousel
job: Arrange photos around a rotating drum seen from inside-out so focus shifts naturally as it spins
visitor_action: drag or swipe to spin; arrows step; tap front photo to open
mobile: smaller radius, larger panels, swipe spins
motion: 3D rotation with inertia and spring snap, slow idle drift with pause control, back photos dim and blur (reduced-motion: simple horizontal slider)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: larger mobile panels, clean reduced-motion floor)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Gallery rotunda: pale plaster ground, matte-white mounts, soft overhead light and floor reflection
notes: Per-panel CSS blur on side photos costs GPU on low-end phones; the pipeline's headless 375 shot captures before images paint (verified fine in a real 375 browser).
